story_description: As a user, I want to clone a Git repository directly from the session creation flow so that I can start working on remote projects without leaving the app.
task_description: Add cloneRepository method to GitWorktreeManager that handles HTTPS and SSH URL cloning with progress reporting and error handling.
atom_description: Implement the core GitWorktreeManager.cloneRepository(url:destination:shallow:progress:) method that spawns git clone as a child process, parses stderr for progress updates, handles authentication failures gracefully, and supports shallow cloning for faster setup.
problem_statement: Users currently can only browse existing local directories when creating sessions. There is no way to clone a remote Git repository directly from within the app, forcing users to switch to Terminal, clone manually, then return to Blaze to browse the cloned directory. This breaks workflow continuity and adds friction to the onboarding experience for new projects.
scope_in: Support HTTPS URLs in format https://github.com/owner/repo or https://github.com/owner/repo.git
Support SSH URLs in format git@github.com:owner/repo.git
Implement shallow clone option via --depth=1 flag for faster cloning of large repos
Parse git clone stderr output to extract progress phases: counting, compressing, receiving, resolving
Report progress percentage and phase via callback closure
Handle git clone exit codes and translate to typed GitError cases
Support cancellation via Task.checkCancellation() between progress updates
scope_out: Git LFS support - large file storage cloning deferred to future atom
Submodule handling - recursive submodule clone deferred to future atom
Custom authentication UI - rely on system git credential helpers and ssh-agent
Branch selection during clone - clone default branch only, branch switching is separate feature
Mirror or bare clone modes - not needed for user workflow
Clone to custom worktree - always clone to standard directory structure
assumptions: Git CLI is installed and available at /usr/bin/git or via PATH
System git credential helper is configured for HTTPS authentication
SSH agent is running and has appropriate keys loaded for SSH URLs
Destination parent directory exists and is writable
Network connectivity is available when clone is initiated
User has read access to the remote repository
constraints: Must use Process/NSTask to spawn git clone - cannot use libgit2 or other libraries
Progress parsing must handle both packed and unpacked progress output formats
Clone operation must be cancellable without leaving partial clone state
All git operations must run on background thread, not main thread
Memory usage must not grow unbounded during large clones
Timeout must be configurable with sensible default of 5 minutes
functional_requirements: FR1: cloneRepository shall accept a url parameter as String and validate it matches HTTPS or SSH URL patterns before proceeding
FR2: cloneRepository shall accept a destination parameter as String specifying the absolute path where the repository will be cloned
FR3: cloneRepository shall accept a shallow parameter as Bool defaulting to false that when true adds --depth=1 to the git clone command
FR4: cloneRepository shall accept a progress callback closure that receives CloneProgress struct updates during the clone operation
FR5: cloneRepository shall spawn git clone with --progress flag to ensure progress output is sent to stderr
FR6: cloneRepository shall parse stderr lines matching pattern 'Receiving objects: N%' and extract percentage as Int
FR7: cloneRepository shall parse stderr lines matching pattern 'Resolving deltas: N%' and extract percentage as Int
FR8: cloneRepository shall detect clone completion when git process exits with code 0 and .git directory exists at destination
FR9: cloneRepository shall throw GitError.invalidURL when url parameter does not match https:// or git@ patterns
FR10: cloneRepository shall throw GitError.authenticationFailed when git exits with code 128 and stderr contains 'Authentication failed'
FR11: cloneRepository shall throw GitError.repositoryNotFound when git exits with code 128 and stderr contains 'not found'
FR12: cloneRepository shall throw GitError.networkError when git exits with code 128 and stderr contains 'Could not resolve host'
FR13: cloneRepository shall clean up partial clone directory on failure before throwing error
FR14: cloneRepository shall respect Task cancellation and terminate git process when cancelled
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Clone operation must not block main thread - all Process spawning and I/O must be on background queue
NFR2: Progress callbacks must be delivered on MainActor for safe UI updates
NFR3: Memory usage during clone must remain constant regardless of repository size - stream stderr line by line
NFR4: Clone of 100MB repository over 100Mbps connection should complete within 30 seconds
NFR5: Error messages must be user-friendly and not expose raw git stderr when possible
implementation_steps: Step 1: Define CloneProgress struct with phase enum (counting, compressing, receiving, resolving, done), percent Int, and message String
Step 2: Define ClonePhase enum with cases counting, compressing, receiving, resolving, done
Step 3: Add GitError cases: invalidURL(String), authenticationFailed(String), repositoryNotFound(String), networkError(String), cloneFailed(Int, String), cloneCancelled
Step 4: Create private helper parseCloneProgress(_ line: String) -> CloneProgress? that uses regex to extract phase and percentage from git stderr lines
Step 5: Create private helper validateCloneURL(_ url: String) throws that validates URL matches https:// or git@ patterns
Step 6: Add cloneRepository(url:destination:shallow:progress:) async throws -> String method signature to GitWorktreeManager
Step 7: In cloneRepository, first call validateCloneURL to check URL format
Step 8: Build git command arguments array: clone, --progress, optionally --depth=1, url, destination
Step 9: Create Process instance with executableURL pointing to git binary
Step 10: Configure Process with arguments array and empty environment to inherit system environment
Step 11: Create Pipe for stderr and assign to Process.standardError
Step 12: Create Task to read stderr pipe data in chunks and split into lines
Step 13: For each stderr line, call parseCloneProgress and if non-nil, dispatch progress callback on MainActor
Step 14: Check Task.isCancelled periodically and if true, call Process.terminate() and throw GitError.cloneCancelled
Step 15: Call Process.run() and Process.waitUntilExit() wrapped in withCheckedThrowingContinuation
Step 16: After process exits, check terminationStatus - if non-zero, parse stderr to determine specific error type and throw appropriate GitError
Step 17: If terminationStatus is 0, verify .git directory exists at destination, return destination path
Step 18: Add cleanup logic in catch block to remove partial clone directory via FileManager.default.removeItem

Add ClonePhase enum to GitWorktreeManager with cases: counting, compressing, receiving, resolving, done

edge_cases: Empty URL string passed - throw GitError.invalidURL with message 'URL cannot be empty'
URL with trailing whitespace - trim whitespace before validation
URL with embedded spaces - throw GitError.invalidURL with message 'URL cannot contain spaces'
Destination directory already exists and is non-empty - git will fail, translate to GitError.cloneFailed with clear message
Destination directory already exists and is empty - git clone should succeed
Destination parent directory does not exist - throw GitError.cloneFailed before spawning git
Destination path is not absolute - throw GitError.cloneFailed with message 'Destination must be absolute path'
Repository requires authentication but credentials not available - throw GitError.authenticationFailed
Repository URL valid but repository deleted or private - throw GitError.repositoryNotFound
Network disconnected mid-clone - throw GitError.networkError after timeout
Clone cancelled while receiving objects - terminate git process, clean up partial directory
Very large repository (multiple GB) - shallow clone recommended, progress updates keep UI responsive
Repository with non-ASCII characters in name - URL encode properly
SSH URL with non-standard port - parse git@host:port:path format correctly
HTTPS URL with username embedded - support https://user@github.com/repo format
Git binary not found at expected path - throw GitError.cloneFailed with message 'Git not installed'
failure_modes: FM1: Git process spawn fails - FileManager cannot execute git binary. Handle by checking git exists before spawn, throw descriptive error.
FM2: Network timeout during clone - git hangs waiting for data. Handle by implementing 5-minute timeout that terminates process and cleans up.
FM3: Disk full during clone - git fails mid-write. Handle by catching clone failure, cleaning up partial directory, throwing GitError.cloneFailed with disk space hint.
FM4: Permission denied on destination - cannot create directory or files. Handle by pre-checking write permission before clone, throwing early with clear message.
FM5: SSH key passphrase required - blocking stdin prompt. Handle by setting GIT_SSH_COMMAND to use batch mode, detect passphrase errors in stderr.
FM6: Progress parsing fails - unexpected stderr format. Handle by continuing clone operation, deliver indeterminate progress updates.
FM7: Process terminated by system - SIGKILL or memory pressure. Handle by detecting non-zero exit without our cancellation flag, throw GitError.cloneFailed.
rollback_plan: To rollback this change: 1) Revert changes to GitWorktreeManager.swift and GitError.swift. 2) Remove any new test files. 3) Run swift build to verify compilation. 4) No data migration needed as this is additive functionality with no persistence changes.

acceptance_tests: Given a valid HTTPS URL and empty destination, when cloneRepository is called, then the repository is cloned and destination contains .git directory
Given a valid SSH URL and configured ssh-agent, when cloneRepository is called, then the repository is cloned successfully
Given shallow=true flag, when cloneRepository is called, then the cloned repo has only one commit in history
Given a progress callback, when cloneRepository is running, then callback receives at least one progress update with percentage
Given an invalid URL format, when cloneRepository is called, then GitError.invalidURL is thrown with descriptive message
Given a nonexistent repository URL, when cloneRepository is called, then GitError.repositoryNotFound is thrown
Given network disconnection mid-clone, when timeout expires, then partial clone directory is removed and GitError.networkError is thrown

risks: Network timeouts on large repositories could leave users waiting with no feedback
Authentication failures for private repos may be confusing without clear error messaging
SSH key passphrase prompts cannot be handled in headless Process mode
Partial clone directories could accumulate if cleanup fails
Git binary location varies across macOS versions and Xcode installations
mitigations: Implement 5-minute configurable timeout with clear progress UI showing data transfer rate
Map all git authentication errors to GitError.authenticationFailed with actionable message suggesting credential helper setup
Set GIT_SSH_COMMAND environment to include BatchMode=yes to fail fast on passphrase prompts
Implement robust cleanup in finally block and on app startup scan for orphaned partial clones
Check multiple git paths: /usr/bin/git, /usr/local/bin/git, xcrun --find git
